command: for table in customers orders order_items audit_events; do case "$table" in customers) q="SELECT customer_id,external_ref,full_name,email,status,created_at FROM legacy_shop.customers ORDER BY customer_id,external_ref,full_name,email,status,created_at";; orders) q="SELECT order_id,customer_id,order_ref,total_cents,status,created_at FROM legacy_shop.orders ORDER BY order_id,customer_id,order_ref,total_cents,status,created_at";; order_items) q="SELECT order_id,line_no,sku,quantity,unit_price_cents FROM legacy_shop.order_items ORDER BY order_id,line_no,sku,quantity,unit_price_cents";; audit_events) q="SELECT event_id,entity_type,entity_id,action,event_time,details FROM legacy_shop.audit_events ORDER BY event_id,entity_type,entity_id,action,event_time,details";; esac; count=$(sudo -H mysql --protocol=socket --batch --raw --skip-column-names -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legacy_shop.$table"); digest=$(sudo -H mysql --protocol=socket --batch --raw --skip-column-names -e "$q" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$table" "$count" "$digest"; done
